knowledge_gaps: Position-preserving masking is underspecified: attention masks alone may leave removed-item information in residual paths or change the final-position readout. The actual encoder is unavailable, so code difficulty 3 is optimistic.

The protocol lacks reproducible choices for text clustering, recency windows, matching tolerances, control counts, candidate construction, seen-item exclusion, rank ties, and diagnostic compute limits. The supplied adapter exposes no held-out labels; target-rank diagnostics need an explicitly authorized source or must remain unavailable.

Recommendation overlap measures sensitivity without establishing useful interest aggregation. TF–IDF clusters can capture brands or boilerplate, and unequal matching can confound interest dependence with position, popularity, or corruption effects. Future potential 8 remains speculative until these controls and a decision rule for subsequent model changes are established.
